body:
**CLEARED at 9dd1c3e3bb05ab08760cf276a69cafec9917388f**: re-gate after two test-only pushes. This replaces the dismissed APPROVE 5694163748 at 5f655f76.

**Delta 5f655f76..9dd1c3e3** (bf3df7d2, 9dd1c3e3): only `CHANGELOG.md`, `test/src/InvSetupTest.PermissionSet.al` and `test/test/Inventory/InvRegistrationTests.Codeunit.al` (one comment line). **`app/` is unchanged**, so the product fix is still `InherentPermissions = X; InherentEntitlements = X;` on `Inventory Registration ori` 10076845 only.

- Test permission set 96972 `Inv Setup Test` now also grants `page "Setup ori" = X`, `codeunit "App Registry ori" = X` and `table "Registered App ori" = X`. That's Execute only on Foundation objects, needed at the supported Foundation 28.0.3.530 floor. This fixes Claude's two amend findings: Page 10077914 Execute in [6490790463](https://github.com/businesscentralal/bc-origo-bifrost-inventory/pull/174#issuecomment-6490790463) and App Registry 10078317 Execute in [6491324875](https://github.com/businesscentralal/bc-origo-bifrost-inventory/pull/174#issuecomment-6491324875).
- It still grants **no Inventory codeunit**, so the regression keeps proving that `Inventory Registration ori` runs only through its own inherent X. No tabledata write was added, and the test still asserts that Setup can't be written directly, the page isn't editable and RefreshLicense is visible.
- No Warehouse or message-type changes. Inventory and Warehouse stay separate.

**Decision:** Gunnar Decision 28.10 [6475209891](https://github.com/businesscentralal/bc-origo-bifrost-inventory/issues/173#issuecomment-6475209891) and [6487616325](https://github.com/businesscentralal/bc-origo-bifrost-inventory/issues/173#issuecomment-6487616325) (`d-20261028-lm92-owner-signoff`).

**COSMO:** `alviss-worker4-inventory173-20261029` / `f018323b75c9` (PR body), confirmed.

**Soft-wait, not blockers:**
- **Claude receipt:** none at `9dd1c3e3` yet; the latest Claude comment is an amend at bf3df7d2. Foundation 98677 already passed 16/16 on bc28-w1 with this unchanged product package installed (6491324875). A clean receipt at this SHA that includes 96972 is still needed before merge.
- **CI (not gated):** run on 9dd1c3e3. The Default build and all static gates pass; the Test job was still in progress when this was posted, and it's the job that was red on the last two heads.

Permission note (OrigoSoftwareSolutions/bc-dev-standards, permission hygiene): the extra Execute grants and `Assignable = true` are acceptable only because this is the test app. They must never move to the product app. I see no elevated product permission beyond the InherentPermissions X pattern.

Not merging from Apps.
